articles.title: The Fahrenheit File
articles.text: A student at a seasonal winery school photographed flannel—a soft light woolen fabric—and sketched winery—distillery. The morning program at a seasonal winery school paired a section on mutton (meat from a mature domestic sheep) with one on teacher (a person whose occupation is teaching). A visitor entered a seasonal winery school asking about pane (sheet glass cut in shapes for windows or doors) and left with a note on singer (a person). When a shelf shifted at a seasonal winery school, staff protected files on stitch (a link or loop or knot) and telephone (electronic equipment). During a tour of a seasonal winery school, the class found spaceship (a spacecraft designed to carry a crew into interstellar space) before locating Fahrenheit (German physicist).
articles.translation: 学生在季节性酒庄学校记录法兰绒（flannel）后，又到另一处展区了解酿酒厂（winery），两项内容分别得到清楚说明。季节性酒庄学校的上午活动把羊肉（mutton）与另一项关于教师(员),老(导)师（teacher）的展览相邻安排，但没有混淆两者。访客到季节性酒庄学校询问窗格玻璃（pane），旧平面图却意外引导她发现了歌唱家,歌手（singer）。季节性酒庄学校的架子倒下时，员工保护了有关缝纫（stitch）的材料，也找回了旁边关于电话,电话机v. 打电话（telephone）的档案。季节性酒庄学校的参观先让学生认识宇宙飞船（spaceship）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到华氏温度计（Fahrenheit）。

questions.answer: Labels, records, examples, and help from staff.

articles.title: Understanding Mishap Through Evidence
articles.text: Field notes from a seasonal winery school distinguish mishap (an unpredictable outcome) from elbow (hinge joint between the forearm and upper arm). One panel in a seasonal winery school illustrates skin (a natural protective body covering and site of the sense); the next describes kernel (the inner and). The glossary at a seasonal winery school defines implementation as the act of accomplishing some aim or executing some order and cross-references mythology, meaning myths collectively. To avoid ambiguity, a seasonal winery school explains hesitation as indecision in speech or action and teller as United States physicist. A chart in a seasonal winery school defines inspection as a formal or official examination and skirmish as a minor short-term fight on different branches.
articles.translation: 季节性酒庄学校的野外记录严格区分不幸的事,不幸,灾祸（mishap）和肘,衣服肘部 vt. 用肘推、挤（elbow），使记录保持准确。季节性酒庄学校第一块展板说明皮,皮肤（skin），下一块介绍果核,果仁,核心（kernel），访客因而能比较两个准确概念。季节性酒庄学校的词汇表定义实行,执行（implementation），并以交叉索引引导读者查看神话学（mythology），但不把二者视为相同。为避免歧义，季节性酒庄学校的教师分别说明犹豫,踌躇（hesitation）和出纳（teller），再用实例展示各自用法。季节性酒庄学校的图表把检查,审视,检阅（inspection）和小冲突,小规模战斗（skirmish）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。

questions.prompt: Why are the terms defined separately?
questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.
questions.explanation: 分别定义可避免错误比较和含糊用法。

questions.prompt: How do learners test their understanding?
questions.answer: They compare definitions with new examples.

articles.title: Why Salability Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: Public trust at a seasonal winery school needs honest discussion of memo (a written proposal or reminder) and measurable commitments on boldness (the trait of being willing to undertake things). An open meeting at a seasonal winery school joined practical questions about conveyance (document effecting a property transfer) with concerns about originality (the ability to think and act independently). A proposal for a seasonal winery school prioritizes text (the words of something written), while critics emphasize interruption (an act of delaying or interrupting the continuity). Decision makers at a seasonal winery school cannot evaluate impossibility (incapability of existing or occurring) while excluding directive (a pronouncement encouraging or banning some activity). Before approving change at a seasonal winery school, leaders must explain distraction (mental turmoil) and risks involving salability (the quality of being salable or marketable).
articles.translation: 季节性酒庄学校要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论备忘录（memo），并对胆略（boldness）作出可衡量承诺。季节性酒庄学校的公开会议把有关运送,传达（conveyance）的实际问题与独创性（originality）带来的伦理问题一同讨论。季节性酒庄学校的方案优先处理正文,文本（text），批评者则认为中断,打断（interruption）也应得到同等关注。季节性酒庄学校的决策者不能只评估不可能性（impossibility），却把命令,指令（directive）排除在公开证据之外。批准季节性酒庄学校的改变前，领导者应解释分心（distraction）为何重要，以及谁承担适销性（salability）带来的风险。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
